# US-002: Give feedback on each option

## User Story

As a Client, I want to leave feedback on each material option, so that Leap Up knows what to adjust.

## Context

"Leave feedback on each option." (L373); "Details / Feedback" (L394).

**OUT — not in the quote (§7).** Build only after Leap Up orders a change request (quote §6).

## Acceptance Criteria

### AC-001 — Feedback saved

- **Type:** happy-path
- **Covers:** FR-material-library-007
- **Screen:** option-feedback

```gherkin
Given option "Character - product pose"
When the client saves feedback "Adjust expression" via Details / Feedback
Then the feedback is shown on that option
```

### AC-002 — Empty feedback

- **Type:** error-path
- **Covers:** FR-material-library-007
- **Screen:** option-feedback
- **Error code:** E-material-library-002

```gherkin
Given the feedback text is empty
When the client saves
Then nothing is saved and E-material-library-002 is shown (wording TBD)
```
